experiment_identity.purpose: Exercise one complete evidence-to-reconstruction-to-receipt path using a deterministic, typed Shader Grammar primitive.
experiment_identity.research_question: Given a persisted normal-incidence reflectance spectrum, can the thin-film model recover the film thickness more accurately than a flat-spectrum alternative?

provenance.custody_statement: This is a deterministic fixture with deliberately fixed provenance timestamps, not a chronological record of each later CI execution. Reference, contract, evaluator, result, and receipt are retained in the repository experiment directory.

scope.generalization_boundary: This benchmark does not establish inverse reconstruction from images or validate a GLSL renderer.
